# packages

Packages are the named CPU, memory, and disk sizes an instance can be created with.

## GET /v1/packages/{package_id}

Operation `package_view`.

Read one package version by id, active or retired. Retired versions stay readable forever: an instance provisioned from one still references it, and so will its invoices.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `package_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [Package](schemas.md#package)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/silos/{silo_id}/packages

Operation `silo_package_list`.

List a silo's package catalog: one entry per family name, showing the version currently offerable. Pass `?all_versions=true` for the full history including superseded and retired rows.

Packages restricted to specific tenants are *hidden*, not merely unprovisionable, so a tenant-scoped principal never sees a package it cannot use. Silo-member gated; cross-silo access returns 404.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silo_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `all_versions` | query | no | boolean | Include superseded and retired versions. The default (`false`) returns the catalog: at most one active version per family name, which is what a caller picking a package to provision from wants. `true` returns every version ever written, which stays readable forever because rate cards reference package ids. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: array of [Package](schemas.md#package)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/silos/{silo_id}/provisioning-policy

Operation `silo_provisioning_policy_view`.

Read a silo's provisioning policy — the instance-sizing mode the silo's tenants may use (`package-only`, `free-form-only`, or `package-or-free-form`). Returns the product default (`package-or-free-form`) when the silo has never written a policy. Silo-member gated so a create UI can present only the permitted forms; cross-silo access and a nonexistent silo both return 404.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silo_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [SiloProvisioningPolicy](schemas.md#siloprovisioningpolicy)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
